parrafo.es: Henry Vera y su equipo atienden renovaciones, pintura, plomería, carpintería y limpieza profesional para condominios y casas en Miami Beach. Puntuales y minuciosos, según sus propios clientes.
parrafo.en: Henry Vera and his team handle renovations, painting, plumbing, carpentry and professional cleaning for condos and homes in Miami Beach. Punctual and thorough, straight from their own clients.

hero.imagen_alt: Vista del horizonte de Miami Beach desde una terraza renovada por VeraCastell Services

parrafo_1.es: VeraCastell Services es el negocio de Henry Vera en Miami Beach. El equipo se encarga de renovaciones, instalaciones eléctricas, drywall, plomería y carpintería en condominios y casas, protegiendo cada ambiente antes de empezar a trabajar.
parrafo_1.en: VeraCastell Services is Henry Vera's business in Miami Beach. The team handles renovations, electrical work, drywall, plumbing and carpentry in condos and homes, protecting every space before the work even starts.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google repiten lo mismo: atención al detalle, trabajo limpio y rápido. Clientes destacan tanto la pintura y la plomería como la limpieza profesional al terminar cada proyecto.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews on Google say the same thing over and over: attention to detail, clean and fast work. Clients call out the painting and plumbing as much as the professional cleaning once each project wraps up.

texto.es: Renovación, pintura, plomería, drywall o limpieza: nos cuentas el proyecto por teléfono.

items.quote: Henry & his team have been great to work with! They are quick to respond and schedule all painting jobs I have needed. Their work is clean and neat and I will definitely continue to work with & recommend their services. Great company :)
We hired Mr. Vera to do cleaning, plumbing, and carpeting work at our condo after we moved out and his team did fast, efficient, and impressive work.
Above and Beyond! VeraCastell is client service at its finest.
